diagnosis.summary: The Chaos Mesh Schedule continuously created NetworkChaos partitions between checkout and email. Checkout's calls to the email service timed out, holding checkout requests until the frontend-proxy 15-second upstream timeout and producing the observed checkout and frontend-proxy latency and error alerts.

The incident begins as checkout and frontend-proxy latency/error alerts. The captured events show Chaos Mesh network-chaos resources targeting the checkout pod and both email pods; I’m now confirming the exact fault mode and whether all three are independently causal.
